verses.1: The memory of Josiah is like a blend of fragrances composed by the work of a perfumer.
verses.2: His remembrance will be sweet like honey in every mouth, and like music at a banquet of wine.
verses.3: He was divinely directed for the repentance of the nation, and he took away the abominations of impiety.
verses.4: And he guided his heart toward the Lord. And during the days of sinners, he strengthened piety.
verses.5: Other than David, and Hezekiah, and Josiah, everyone committed sin.
verses.6: For the kings of Judah abandoned the law of the Most High, and they held contempt for the fear of God.
verses.7: For they gave their kingdom to foreigners, and their glory to a strange people.
verses.8: They set fire to the chosen city of sanctity, and they made its streets desolate, in accord with the hand of Jeremiah.
verses.9: For they treated him wickedly, though he was consecrated as a prophet from his mother’s womb: to overthrow, and to root out, and to destroy, and also to rebuild and to renew.
verses.10: It was Ezekiel who saw a vision of glory, which was revealed to him with the chariot of the Cherubim.
verses.11: For it called to mind the enemies under the figure of rain, to do good to those who have revealed the upright ways.
verses.12: And may the bones of the twelve prophets spring up from their place. For they strengthened Jacob, and they redeemed themselves with a virtuous faith.
verses.13: How will we magnify Zerubbabel? For he, too, was like a signet on the right hand.
verses.14: So also was Jesus, the son of Jozadak, who in their days built the house, and raised up a holy temple to the Lord, as a preparation for everlasting glory.
verses.15: And may Nehemiah be remembered for a long time. He raised up for us the walls that had been torn down. And he made firm the gates and the bars. He raised up our houses.
verses.16: No one has been born upon the earth like Enoch. And he was also taken up from the earth.
verses.17: And there was no one like Joseph, who was a man born to be foremost among his brothers, the firmament of his clan, a guide to his brethren, the mainstay of his people.
verses.18: And his bones were visited, and after death, they prophesied.
verses.19: Shem and Seth obtained glory among men. And above every soul, at the very beginning, was Adam. [ Sirach 50 ]
